title: Combining claim values for jurisdiction
summary: Aggregation concerns when several claims may be added together to satisfy a jurisdictional amount. The answer depends on the parties and whether the claims are separate or share a common undivided interest.
notes: Procedural permission to join claims does not itself authorize adding their values for jurisdiction. Exxon addresses supplemental jurisdiction over related claims and should not be restated as unlimited aggregation.

sections.Meaning: Aggregation concerns when several claims may be added together to satisfy a jurisdictional amount. The answer depends on the parties and whether the claims are separate or share a common undivided interest.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify who owns each claim and against whom it is asserted. Separate a single plaintiff’s multiple claims against one defendant from separate plaintiffs’ claims. Then check whether a special statute such as CAFA changes the ordinary treatment.
